name: Glass Bridge For Lucky Blocks!
desc:
💗Valentine Update💗
🩵 Get past the Glass Bridge and break the Lucky Blocks!

1. Cross the dangerous glass tiles before you fall! 💥
2. Reach the end to break a Lucky Block full of surprises! 🎁
3. Collect rare brainrots and bring them back to your plot for cash! 🧠💰
